The '''Mission to the Dromund Kalakar shipyards''' was conducted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|
Republic]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] in a attempt to steal the [[VX-9 Mailoc]] design specifications from the [[Dromund Kalakar shipyards]]. The mission was a success, and the [[VX-9 Mailoc|VX-9 Redeemer]] was manufactured for Republic [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].
